prompt:
Correct the tower geometry in Image1 using real pagoda photographs Images2 and3. This is Zhenfeng Pagoda, an octagonal MASONRY pagoda, NOT a stack of ornate Chinese timber pavilions. Preserve exactly SEVEN wall storeys and complete portrait1024x1536 framing, thin black contours and blank plaques. Make the SIX intermediate eaves much thinner and nearly flat, simple projecting masonry-cornice bands with modest small corner lifts only, as visible in the photo; remove exaggerated layered tile roofs, large curled corner tips and invented timber pavilion brackets. Keep the real small masonry dougong-like bracket pattern as restrained short contours. White wall belts and arched openings, low pierced balustrades. The top cap is a steep straight-sided octagonal truncated pyramid with simple flat slopes, NO curled pavilion corners. The broad dark base-skirt roof is a SINGLE continuous eight-sided octagonal sloping roof; remove the invented central gable/projection and make all eight sides the same height. Keep the slender ringed finial and lowest octagonal base uncut. No reconstruction, no extra storeys. Thin sparse black ink ONLY; every wall and unmarked area flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, alpha255 everywhere. No transparency, shadows, texture, crosshatching, grey fill, scenery, trees, captions, characters or border.
Image4 is a recent frontal photograph: use it to match flat cornice profiles, small arched perforations in parapets, and add the fine diagonal finial-support chains from the finial down to the top roof corners. Make the finial slender with evenly tapering bulb/ring segments as photographed, not oversized globes. Keep every true sky space between chains pure white.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is STYLE MASTER ONLY: match elegant delicate slightly organic thin black contours, restrained detail and generous white space. Images 2 and 3 are SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: 2022 aerial photographs of the real Zhenfeng Pagoda (振风塔), Yingjiang Temple, Anqing, Anhui. Image 4 is a 2008 close view clarifying masonry bracket and balustrade construction, not its dark finial color or the foreground hall. Depict ONLY this pagoda, entire apex and lowest base visible, remove all surrounding halls and scenery. Photo3 is overhead and proves octagonal plan and bottom pavilion-shaped attached eave; translate to near frontal facade-level view, verticals vertical and minimal perspective, not an aerial view.
Exactly SEVEN octagonal tower STOREYS progressively taper upward, each with its main eave and projecting balcony/balustrade. Do not confuse the bottommost wide dark attached eave with an eighth tower storey. Preserve the additional broad octagonal base skirt roof seen in aerial photo3 around the bottom storey. White masonry wall belts punctuated by little arched openings, projecting masonry imitation-timber brackets below the eaves and rows of low pierced parapets. The uppermost storey has a steep dark octagonal pyramidal cap; above it a long slender finial with distinct bead/ring segments, not another pavilion. Draw real masonry bracket forms, no generic stacked Chinese timber pavilion roofs. Seven wall tiers total, bottom skirt as eave only.
Refined sparse BLACK INK drawing on fully OPAQUE perfectly flat PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas, alpha255 EVERYWHERE, NOT transparent. All unmarked walls, openings and exterior space remain white; no filled black windows. NO shading, broad grey fill, crosshatching, paper texture, grain, gradient, shadow, glow, halo or checkerboard. The white paper will be removed locally afterward. Selective small arches and sparse contour details, do not outline every brick.
Portrait 1024x1536, tower centered at about 82% canvas height, complete finial and foot uncut, balanced white side margins. No trees, people, halls, river, sky, rails outside tower, lamp fixtures, text, Chinese characters, labels, captions, calligraphy, border or watermark. Ignore all lettering; leave plaques blank. Do not restore an imaginary ancient appearance.
generation_history.reason: 塔檐过于木构楼阁化，底层附檐有不实中央突出
